research_question: Does one chronological presentation of the same compact prefix improve later five-minute direction ranking versus the existing fixed mixed presentation?

independent_actual_order_verification.interval_only_data: Original saved JSON metadata and generated integer IDs; no predictions, targets, input datasets, models, weights or TEST were read.

what_is_and_is_not_proved.window_chronology: The actual run source constructs each local M5 sequence in increasing time, checks every completed bar <= its decision, and checks MTF availability <= decision. Randomization permutes decision examples, not bars within a sequence. This is source evidence, not new physical-data causal replay.
what_is_and_is_not_proved.cutoffs: Actual source validates strictly chronological TRAIN/later axes and loss uses only observed nonzero TRAIN outcomes whose terminal time is strictly before the TRAIN cutoff. This does not audit every upstream feature clock.
what_is_and_is_not_proved.order_effect: No chronological-versus-mixed native fit has been run; no claim that either order is better or explains weak later direction.
what_is_and_is_not_proved.small_last_batch: Original first full B16 had 48 eligible cells and final B2 had 6; BCE is mean per eligible batch cell. Thus a last-batch cell coefficient was 1/6 versus 1/48 in that full batch. The same final two parent IDs recur in all three passes. AdamW, gradients and clipping prevent interpreting this coefficient as an 8x overall causal or final-model impact.
what_is_and_is_not_proved.not_online: Chronological presentation under whole-prefix normalization and a fixed end-of-prefix label maturity cutoff is an offline batch experiment, not a prequential or live adaptation simulation.

measured_baseline.limitations: One repeatedly reused development fold, not independent generalization or economic edge.

proposed_comparison.control: Reuse the original one-pass sign-only saved later predictions; do not retrain or repeat the claimed control.
proposed_comparison.candidate: One fresh one-pass compact sign-only native fit with ascending chronological TRAIN parent IDs. No indicator, loss, architecture, normalization, seed, optimizer, horizon, parent-set or target change.
proposed_comparison.fit_geometry: Same 47,602 parents, batch size 16, same existing treatment of the final two rows and missing/zero/immature targets; max 2,976 optimizer updates. Count and report empty batches and actual optimizer updates in both arms; do not claim an order-only numerical comparison if step-count or other contract mismatch appears.
proposed_comparison.initial_parity: Before any candidate update compare the same original fixed 256 training parent IDs and their initial predictions; check original model, buffers, optimizer state and RNG. The parent_order field is intentionally different and must be separately hash-bound and verified. Current changed ONLINE needs a fresh genuine own-initial qualification.
proposed_comparison.evaluation: On the exact same later parents, clocks, labels and masks, primary 5-minute AUC compared with one-pass and 0.5 using paired UTC-day and UTC-week blocks; report 1/15min as secondary, plus unweighted logloss, Brier, prior and up/down prediction coverage. No selected thresholds or checkpoint.
proposed_comparison.uncertainty: Predeclare same 10,000 paired day/week block replicates and existing seed constants 20261027/20261028; 4 primary AUC intervals (candidate-vs-baseline and candidate-vs-0.5 under day/week) use Bonferroni per-interval alpha 0.05/4. Report probabilities and proper scores separately; no after-the-fact acceptance.
proposed_comparison.no_selection: Do not switch to chronological permanently from one reused fold. Repeat on a predeclared separate fold only under a fresh bounded decision if first result supports it.

required_before_any_genuine_execution: Review the minimal way to admit an alternate order without altering or weakening existing one-pass/continuation recipes, feature causality, exact state, hardware and one-job guards.
Qualify actual original-versus-current initial predictions and state on the same rows before any training step.
Prepare an exact source-hash-bound one-shot recipe/campaign and new training authorization; current training_enabled remains false.
Existing native campaign requires a physical Windows reboot after campaign preparation. Current handover explicitly forbids steering restart without the operator changing that boundary.
No CONTROL, sealed TEST, live/paper, broker, orders, spending, promotion or Exit.

four_chronological_development_folds.order: Each fold uses its own fixed MT19937 permutation of its complete prefix; same order within its resumed windows.
four_chronological_development_folds.interpretation: Across four reused chronological development folds the zero-logit UP decision share moves from 13.65% to 100%, while realized UP share remains 50.68% to 51.58%. This is threshold/class imbalance and not proof the underlying scores are constant, nor proof the training order causes the imbalance. Models and training prefixes differ between folds. Across these full five-minute cohorts, average predicted UP probabilities range from 49.50% to 50.57%; changing the threshold alone cannot improve score AUC.

pooled_simple_direction_accuracy.scope: Descriptive point comparison on four reused development folds; zero-logit UP/DOWN decision and fixed own-prefix majority. Overlapping outcomes, no interval, no trading rule, no new generalization or economic claim.
